author: Naveen Gautam
review_text: This is the first time I am reviewing an app on Playstore. Esewa is the worst of all mobile wallets in Nepal. I have been trying to send money for my rent but the app does not load at all. Today too, I tried sending money to my mobile phone. I couldn't. Goodness, what's wrong with the app? It's interface is extremely laggy and does not function well as compared to other apps like Khalti, IMEPay, etc. There is urgently a need of some fix to these issues.
